čima-dāča: či — you; oblique stem čima- + ablative -dāča (long form of -da-ača), 'from you' (pronoun + case; Ming 自) [你自]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
tan-i: tan- — you (plural polite; stem of ta before a case ending); accusative -i, 'you' as object (pronoun + case) [您行]
hodutai: hodun — star (the glossary's hodun, hodud; the -n drops before -tai); possessive -tai, 'star-having' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [星有的]
teṅgeri: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky god (noun) [天] · also a man's name, Tenggeri (Ming 人名) [人名]
horčižu: horči- — to go around, circle (stem inferred; Ming 繞); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [繞着]
ulus: ulus — realm, nation, people (noun) [國] · also (Ming 百姓 'the common people') 'people, subjects'
bulγa: bulγa — revolt, rebellion (noun; Ming 反) [反] · also 'turmoil, fighting' (Ming 厮殺 'slaughter')
oron: oro- — to enter; converb -n, 'entering' (verb, converb) [入] · also oron, 'bed, bedding' (noun; Ming 被窠 'quilt'), as in ordo ger … oron dotora 'within my bed'; the same spelling as oro- 'to enter' and oro 'place, seat'
gür: Gür — Gür, a name or title (here Gür Qan; Ming 人名; the Mongol meaning is unclear) [人名] · also gür, adjective 'all, whole, universal' (e.g. gür ulus 'all the people'; Ming 普)
künžile-deġen: künžile — quilt, bedcovering (Ming 被子); -deġen: reflexive-possessive dative: in one's own (front-vowel form) [被子 自的行]
kebten: kebte- — to lie down; converb -n, 'lying' (verb, converb) [臥]
teimü: teimü — so, thus, it is so (adverb) [那般]
čaγ-tur: čaγ — time, season; dative-locative -tur, 'at the time' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [時 裏]
jabuba-že: jabu- — to walk, go about; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 行了 也者︀) [行了 也者︀]
bolba-že: bol- — to become, be; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed', 'agreed to be, became' (verb, past + particle; Ming 肻做了 'agreed to be') [肻做了 也者︀]
buruγ̇udču: buruγ̇ud- — to flee, hide, take cover (stem uncertain; Ming 逃躱 'flee and hide'); converb -ču, 'fleeing' (verb, converb after a consonant) [逃躱着]
jabuba: jabu- — to go, march; past -ba, 'went, marched' (verb, past tense, back-vowel form) [行了]
bulγalduqui-dur: bulγa- — to contend, fight (the glossary's bulγa-; Ming 厮殺 'slaughter'); reciprocal -ldu-, participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'when fighting one another' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [厮殺︀ 時]
boγda: boγda — sacred, holy; here 'wise, venerable' (adjective; Ming 賢明 'wise and enlightened') [賢明]
eke-jüġen: eke-jüġen — own mother (eke 'mother' + reflexive-possessive -jüġen; here 'their own') [娘 自的]
duran: dura — heart, mind, will; -n, reflexive-possessive (uncertain), 'one's own mind' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 心) [心]
sün: sün — fresh mare's milk (noun) [生馬妳子] · also 'milk' in general (Ming 乳), the mother's milk a foal sucks
mün: mün — just, the very, indeed (particle; Ming 是 'is', elsewhere 只那 'that same') [是] · also 'only, just' (Ming 只) · also 'just, the very' (Ming 只他)
ese-ü: ese — not (negative of the past); -ü, a question particle (Ming 不曾 … 麽) (negative + particle) [不曾] · also ese-ü with the Ming 不曾 only and no 麽, so the question force is uncertain
qalaγ̇un-ača: qalaγ̇un — hot, heat; ablative -ača, 'from the heat' (adjective/noun + case, back-vowel form) [自熱處]
γarulaγ̇a: γar- — to go out, to go up; linking vowel + -laγ̇a, 'went up' (verb, past narrative; ending uncertain) [上去來]
tan-u: tan-u — your (plural) (ta, stem tan-, + genitive -u) [您的]
qamuγ: qamuγ — all, the whole (Ming 普) (quantifier) [普]
ulus-i: ulus — people, realm; accusative -i, 'the people (object)' (noun + case) [百姓行]
čisu-ban: čisun — blood (the n lost before the ending); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own blood' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form after a vowel) [血自的(行)]
hirmes: hirmes — turning, a turn (the word as printed; stem unknown, the Ming 轉 'turn, revolve') (verb form or noun, uncertain) [轉] · also 'blink of an eye' (noun; Ming 瞬眼 'blink'), as in hirmes ülü kin 'not doing a blink, without a blink'
kin: ki- — to do, make; converb -n, 'doing' (verb, converb) [做]
talbin: talbi- — to put down, let go; converb -n, 'letting go' (verb, converb) [放]
qanču-ban: qanču — sleeve (noun); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 袖 自的行) [袖 自的行]
kürtele: kür- — to reach; -tele, 'until, up to' (verb, terminal converb) [到了]
boγtalažu: boγta — a headdress; verb-maker -la- + converb -žu, 'putting on the headdress' (noun + verb-maker + converb) [固姑冠帶着]
büseležü: büse — belt; verb-maker -le- + converb -žü, 'belting up' (noun + verb-maker + converb) [繫着]
ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
egemēče: egem — shoulder (stem inferred from the Ming 肩甲); ablative -ēče, 'from the shoulder' (written with a long vowel) (noun + case) [肩甲行]
ere-lüġe: ere — man, male; comitative -lüġe, 'together with a man' (noun + case) [男子 一同]
sačaγ̇un: sačaγ̇u — alike, equally; ending -n, adverbial (uncertain) (adverb) [齊每]
bolγaqu: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + future participle -qu, 'to be made into, to be made' (verb, causative participle) [敎做了]
küžüġün-eče: küžüġün — neck, nape (Ming 項頸); ablative -eče, 'from the neck' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [項頸行]
küġün-lüġe: küġün — man, person; comitative -lüġe, 'together with a man' (noun + case) [人 一同]
ere-jin: ere — man, male; genitive -jin, 'of a man' (noun + case; -jin after a vowel; Ming 男子 的) [男子 的]
aγta-jin: aγta — gelding; genitive -jin (after a vowel), 'of the gelding' (noun + case) [騸馬 的]
kürgežü: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); converb -žü, 'delivering' (verb, converb) [送到着] · also with Ming 敎到着 'making (it) reach', a causative reading (uncertain)
edöġe: edöġe — now (adverb) [今] · also 'now' with Ming 如今
sai: sai — good, fine (adjective; Ming 好) [好] · also 'just now, only now' (Ming 恰纔, read against the usual sai 'good'), in aqa deġü-dür sai ižilidülčen büküi-dür, 'when brother and brother are only just growing used to each other'
sedkižü: sedki- — to think; converb -žü, 'thinking' (verb, converb) [想着]
amui: a- — to be; present -mui, 'is, there is' (verb, present tense) [有]
bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
gegeġen: gegeġen — bright, shining; also 'brightness' (adjective/noun) [明] · also 'bright, clear' (Ming 明白 'plain, clear') · also with Ming 白 'white, bright', of the day: gegeġen üdür 'bright day'
naγ̇ur: naγ̇ur — lake (noun; Ming 海子 'sea-child') [海︀子] · also with Ming 海子般 'lake-like', in naγ̇ur baildu baildužu, 'standing in array like a lake'
sedkiltü: sedkil — heart, mind; -tü 'having', 'hearted, minded' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [心有的]
